_comment: Copy to fixtures.local.json and fill in with your own sessions. That file is gitignored so real ticket keys never enter git. Generate a starting point with: bun run fixtures.ts
_mustMatch: Session id prefix -> the ticket the extractor must return. Pick sessions where you know the answer, ideally a mix: some where the ticket is in the aiTitle, at least one where it is only in your opening message.
_mustNotMatch: Session id prefix -> why it must return null. The important half. Pick chore and incident sessions whose bytes mention a ticket somewhere but which are not about that ticket. These catch an implementation that regexes raw JSONL and picks up the stale slug field.

mustNotMatch.cafe0003: git chore; a stale slug field names a ticket the session never worked on
